-- JumpscareController (ServerScriptService)
-- Uses an actual light raycast (multi-ray cone) and checks light color.
-- Monster is a Model whose PrimaryPart is a BasePart.

local ServerStorage = game:GetService("ServerStorage")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local Workspace = game:GetService("Workspace")

local SPOTS_FOLDER = Workspace:WaitForChild("Spots")
local MONSTER_TEMPLATE = ServerStorage:WaitForChild("jumpscare")
local FLASH_EVENT_NAME = "FlashEvent"

local FLASH_RANGE = 40         -- max distance for rays
local RETREAT_COOLDOWN = 17     -- seconds hidden before reappearing
local TELEPORT_INTERVAL_MIN = 6
local TELEPORT_INTERVAL_MAX = 13

-- Light raycast parameters
local CONE_ANGLE_DEGREES = 20  -- half-angle of the cone (flashlight spread)
local RAY_SAMPLES = 9          -- number of rays (1 center + others around)
local COLOR_TOLERANCE = 0.12   -- how close colors must be (0..1)

-- Acceptable color (change to taste). Example: white flash required.
local REQUIRED_COLOR = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)

-- Create RemoteEvent if missing
local flashEvent = ReplicatedStorage:FindFirstChild(FLASH_EVENT_NAME)
if not flashEvent then
	flashEvent = Instance.new("RemoteEvent")
	flashEvent.Name = FLASH_EVENT_NAME
	flashEvent.Parent = ReplicatedStorage
end

local function getSpots()
	local spots = {}
	for _, v in ipairs(SPOTS_FOLDER:GetChildren()) do
		if v:IsA("BasePart") then
			table.insert(spots, v)
		end
	end
	return spots
end

local function farthestSpotFrom(pos, spots)
	local best, bestDist = nil, -math.huge
	for _, s in ipairs(spots) do
		local d = (s.Position - pos).Magnitude
		if d > bestDist then
			bestDist = d
			best = s
		end
	end
	return best
end

local function teleportModelToSpot(model, spot)
	if not model or not model.Parent or not model.PrimaryPart or not spot then return end
	model:SetPrimaryPartCFrame(spot.CFrame + Vector3.new(0, 0.5, 0))
end

local function setModelHidden(model, hidden)
	if not model then return end
	for _, part in ipairs(model:GetDescendants()) do
		if part:IsA("BasePart") then
			part.CanCollide = not hidden
			if hidden then
				part.Transparency = 1
			else
				part.Transparency = 0
			end
			part.Anchored = true
		elseif part:IsA("Decal") or part:IsA("Texture") then
			part.Transparency = hidden and 1 or 0
		end
	end
end

-- color distance helper (returns 0 = identical, larger = more different)
local function colorDistance(a, b)
	return math.abs(a.R - b.R) + math.abs(a.G - b.G) + math.abs(a.B - b.B)
end

-- Attempts to find a gameplay flashlight origin & direction for the player:
-- Expected setup on player: a Tool named "Flashlight" with an Attachment "LightOrigin" under its Handle,
-- and a SpotLight/PointLight/SurfaceLight as a child (used to read Color).
local function getPlayerLightOriginAndCFrame(player)
	if not player.Character then return end
	-- look for a Tool named "Flashlight" in character or Backpack
	local tool = player.Character:FindFirstChild("Flashlight") or player:FindFirstChild("Backpack") and player.Backpack:FindFirstChild("Flashlight")
	if not tool then
		-- fallback: use Head CFrame
		local head = player.Character:FindFirstChild("Head")
		if head then
			return head.CFrame, head.Position
		end
		return nil
	end

	-- origin attachment
	local originAttachment = nil
	local handle = tool:FindFirstChild("Light")
	if handle then
		originAttachment = handle:FindFirstChild("LightOrigin") -- Attachment
		if originAttachment then
			return originAttachment.WorldCFrame, originAttachment.WorldPosition
		else
			-- fallback to handle CFrame
			return handle.CFrame, handle.Position
		end
	end

	return nil
end

-- Get the light instance and its Color property (if present)
local function getToolLightColor(tool)
	if not tool then return nil end
	for _, child in ipairs(tool:GetDescendants()) do
		if child:IsA("SpotLight") or child:IsA("PointLight") or child:IsA("SurfaceLight") then
			return child.Color, child.Parent -- return color and parent (to get origin)
		end
	end
	return nil
end

-- Build sampled ray directions in a cone around centerDir.
local function buildConeDirections(centerCFrame, coneAngleDeg, samples)
	local dir = centerCFrame.LookVector
	local right = centerCFrame.RightVector
	local up = centerCFrame.UpVector
	local angleRad = math.rad(coneAngleDeg)

	local dirs = {}
	-- center ray
	table.insert(dirs, dir)

	-- ring samples (evenly spaced)
	for i = 1, samples - 1 do
		-- polar coordinates on unit circle
		local t = (i - 1) / (samples - 1) * math.pi * 2
		-- produce an offset within cone: use sin of angle to distribute inside
		local u = (i % 3 == 0) and 0.6 or 0.4 -- small subtle variation to cover cone
		local x = math.cos(t) * math.tan(angleRad) * u
		local y = math.sin(t) * math.tan(angleRad) * u
		local sample = (dir + right * x + up * y).Unit
		table.insert(dirs, sample)
	end
	return dirs
end

-- raycast from origin along dir * range, returns raycast result
local function doRay(origin, dir, range, ignoreList)
	local rayParams = RaycastParams.new()
	rayParams.FilterDescendantsInstances = ignoreList or {}
	rayParams.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Blacklist
	rayParams.IgnoreWater = true
	local result = Workspace:Raycast(origin, dir * range, rayParams)
	return result
end

-- SERVER-SIDE VALIDATION: simulate a flashlight beam by casting multiple rays from the tool/light origin.
-- Requirements:
--  - One of the rays must hit a descendant of the monster within range.
--  - The flashlight's actual Color (SpotLight/PointLight/SurfaceLight) must match REQUIRED_COLOR within tolerance.
local function validateFlash(player, monster)
	if not player or not player.Character or not monster or not monster.PrimaryPart then return false end

	-- find player's flashlight tool and light color (if present)
	local tool = player.Character:FindFirstChild("Flashlight") or (player:FindFirstChild("Backpack") and player.Backpack:FindFirstChild("Flashlight"))
	local color, colorParent = nil, nil
	if tool then
		color, colorParent = getToolLightColor(tool)
	end

	-- if color exists, compare to REQUIRED_COLOR
	if color then
		if colorDistance(color, REQUIRED_COLOR) > COLOR_TOLERANCE then
			-- color doesn't match required color
			return false
		end
	end
	-- if no light color found, we still allow if player has a "Flashlight" tool but no light object (optional).
	-- if you want to require a light instance, uncomment the next lines:
	-- if not color then return false end

	-- determine origin and central CFrame (direction)
	local originCFrame, originPos = nil, nil
	if tool and colorParent then
		-- prefer light's parent (like handle) as origin if available
		originCFrame = (colorParent:IsA("BasePart") and colorParent.CFrame) or getPlayerLightOriginAndCFrame(player)
		originPos = (colorParent:IsA("BasePart") and colorParent.Position) or (originCFrame and originCFrame.Position)
	else
		local got = getPlayerLightOriginAndCFrame(player)
		if got then
			originCFrame, originPos = got, (got and got.Position)
		end
	end

	-- as a final fallback, use Head
	if not originCFrame then
		local head = player.Character:FindFirstChild("Head")
		if head then
			originCFrame = head.CFrame
			originPos = head.Position
		else
			return false
		end
	end

	-- build directions and raycast
	local dirs = buildConeDirections(originCFrame, CONE_ANGLE_DEGREES, RAY_SAMPLES)
	local ignoreList = {player.Character}
	for _, d in ipairs(dirs) do
		local result = doRay(originPos, d, FLASH_RANGE, ignoreList)
		if result and result.Instance then
			-- valid only if hit monster or its descendants
			if result.Instance:IsDescendantOf(monster) then
				return true
			end
		end
	end

	return false
end

-- create one monster at a given spot
local function spawnMonsterAtSpot(spot)
	local clone = MONSTER_TEMPLATE:Clone()
	clone.Parent = Workspace

	if not clone.PrimaryPart then
		clone.PrimaryPart = clone:FindFirstChild("Body") or clone:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") or clone:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("BasePart")
	end

	if clone.PrimaryPart and spot then
		clone:SetPrimaryPartCFrame(spot.CFrame + Vector3.new(0, 0.5, 0))
	end

	for _, p in ipairs(clone:GetDescendants()) do
		if p:IsA("BasePart") then
			p.Anchored = true
			p.CanCollide = true
		end
	end

	return clone
end

-- main manager
spawn(function()
	wait(0.5)
	local spots = getSpots()
	if #spots == 0 then
		warn("[JumpscareController] No Spots found under Workspace.Spots")
		return
	end

	local currentSpot = spots[math.random(1, #spots)]
	local monster = spawnMonsterAtSpot(currentSpot)
	local state = "idle" -- "idle", "hidden"
	local retreatUntil = 0

	-- teleport cycle loop (no movement) — randomly teleport to another spot occasionally
	spawn(function()
		while monster and monster.Parent do
			if state == "hidden" then
				-- stay hidden until cooldown
				if tick() >= retreatUntil then
					-- unhide and resume idle
					setModelHidden(monster, false)
					state = "idle"
				end
			else
				local waitTime = math.random(TELEPORT_INTERVAL_MIN, TELEPORT_INTERVAL_MAX)
				wait(waitTime)
				if not monster or not monster.Parent then break end

				local newSpot = spots[math.random(1, #spots)]
				if #spots > 1 then
					local tries = 0
					while newSpot == currentSpot and tries < 8 do
						newSpot = spots[math.random(1, #spots)]
						tries = tries + 1
					end
				end

				teleportModelToSpot(monster, newSpot)
				currentSpot = newSpot
				wait(0.6 + math.random()*1.8)
			end
			wait()
		end
	end)

	-- Flash handling: validate then retreat (hide + teleport to far spot)
	flashEvent.OnServerEvent:Connect(function(player)
		if not monster or not monster.Parent then return end
		if state == "hidden" then return end -- already hidden, ignore
		if validateFlash(player, monster) then
			-- hide immediately
			setModelHidden(monster, true)
			state = "hidden"
			retreatUntil = tick() + RETREAT_COOLDOWN

			-- teleport to farthest spot while hidden
			local playerRoot = player.Character and player.Character.PrimaryPart
			if playerRoot then
				local far = farthestSpotFrom(playerRoot.Position, spots) or currentSpot
				teleportModelToSpot(monster, far)
				currentSpot = far
			end

			-- schedule unhide (redundant safety)
			delay(RETREAT_COOLDOWN + 0.1, function()
				if monster and monster.Parent and state == "hidden" and tick() >= retreatUntil then
					setModelHidden(monster, false)
					state = "idle"
				end
			end)
		end
	end)

	-- respawn if destroyed
	monster.AncestryChanged:Connect(function(child, parent)
		if not parent then
			-- small delay then respawn at random spot
			delay(2 + math.random()*3, function()
				local s = getSpots()
				if #s == 0 then return end
				currentSpot = s[math.random(1, #s)]
				monster = spawnMonsterAtSpot(currentSpot)
				state = "idle"
				retreatUntil = 0
			end)
		end
	end)
end)

--[ Phase 1 (0:00 – 3:00) — Introduction, Unease

Window Monster: Starts gently — a few window rattles on the first floor. Easy to spot and secure.

	Whisperer: Only faint whispers/footsteps, nothing aggressive yet. Player learns to doubt their hearing.

	Goal: Teach the player windows are important, while planting mistrust in sound.

		Phase 2 (3:00 – 6:00) — Tension Builds

		Window Monster: More windows start rattling, including upstairs. Multiple at once can happen.

		Whisperer: Starts mimicking window sounds, forcing the player to second-guess.

		Knocker: Introduced — occasional knocks on doors. If the player opens recklessly → scare.

		Goal: Add pressure. Player must now juggle windows, fake sounds, and door paranoia.

		Phase 3 (6:00 – 9:00) — House Comes Alive

		Window Monster: Intensifies — faster window activity, possible glass cracks.

		Whisperer: Louder, layered misdirection. Sometimes whispers from the same room.

		Knocker: Doors slam shut randomly; knocks escalate.

		Crawl: Introduced — skittering shadows across ceilings/walls. Player paranoia peaks.

		Goal: Movement inside the house no longer feels safe.

		Phase 4 (9:00 – 12:00) — Overload

		Window Monster: Near-constant activity; risk of break-ins if ignored.

			Whisperer: Full auditory chaos — fake glass breaking, calling player’s name.

			Knocker: Multiple doors slam at once. Sometimes doors won’t open right away.

			Crawl: Drops into a room briefly — forces the player to retreat or risk being hit.

			Breathless: Introduced — one random room at a time becomes suffocating. Staying inside = danger.

			Goal: Player feels trapped between threats, forced to make quick but risky decisions.

			Phase 5 (12:00 – 15:00) — The Breaking Point

			Window Monster: Final assault — glass shatters if ignored for even a few seconds.

					Whisperer: Whispers overlap real sounds until it’s nearly impossible to tell them apart.

					Knocker: Frenzied banging across multiple doors.

					Crawl: Appears more boldly — skitters through hallways.

					Breathless: 2–3 rooms can suffocate at once.

					Ticking Man: Final arrival — clocks tick violently; staying in a room too long freezes player time briefly, giving the Window Monster more advantage.

					Goal: Full chaos. Every mechanic collides. Survival feels barely possible.

					End Condition

					Survive until 15:00 → Dawn light breaks through the 14 windows.

					Fail → Window Monster breaches too many times, or player succumbs to another monster’s effect (sanity/suffocation/attack).
--]

--[ Extras 

	1. The Doppel

Theme: Identity horror.

	Behavior: Sometimes the player glimpses a copy of themselves walking into another room. If followed, it vanishes. If ignored too often, it replaces the player’s reflection in windows or mirrors.

	Mechanic: If the Doppel gets too strong, it takes the player’s place (insta-fail).

	Purpose: Personal fear — makes the player distrust themselves.

	2. The Marionette

Theme: Loss of control.

	Behavior: Appears as a faint shadow figure behind the player. Occasionally seizes partial control: forces the character to step forward, look somewhere, or open a door against their will.

	Mechanic: Rare at first, but later interrupts at critical window moments.

	Purpose: Body horror — even the player’s own inputs can’t be trusted.

	3. The Lantern Widow

Theme: Twisted mimicry.

	Behavior: A tall figure that carries a flickering lantern, visible through windows or stairwell shadows. Its light mimics the player’s, confusing them.

	Mechanic: If followed, leads the player into a trap room (auto-scare). If avoided too long, it enters the house directly.

	Purpose: Visual misdirection — contrasts Whisperer’s sound-based lies with a sight-based lure.

	4. The Murmur Nest

Theme: Parasitic infection.

	Behavior: In some rooms, faint murmurs come from behind the walls. Staying too long reveals hands or faces pressing out from the wallpaper.

	Mechanic: Too much exposure causes the room itself to attack (walls grab, sanity drain).

	Purpose: Makes walls unsafe, breaking the idea that the house itself protects you.

	5. The Pallid Nurse

Theme: Invasive caretaker.

	Behavior: A pale, eyeless figure that tries to “help” the player — offering whispered advice, pointing at windows/doors.

	Mechanic: Half the time, she’s wrong. Following her directions leads straight into danger. Ignoring her makes her more aggressive.

	Purpose: Psychological manipulation — the player questions whether to trust or doubt an NPC-like presence.]



Arthur’s Knot **

Effect: Presents moral dilemmas framed as immediate choices (save a vague figure vs. secure a window). Both options feel equally right/wrong.

	Mechanic: Decision paralysis and guilt loops.

	Counter: Implement a quick-decision hotkey that executes a neutral fallback action.

	The Silent Room

Effect: Certain rooms suddenly lose all sound cues for a few seconds — no footsteps, no window rattles.

	Mechanic: Player can’t trust audio anymore and may waste time checking safe areas unnecessarily.

	Counter: Visual indicators (motion of curtains, flickering lights) help distinguish safe windows.

	The Fading Floor

	Effect: For brief moments, the floor appears to disappear or visually shift (checkerboards, holes, false depth).

		Mechanic: Creates vertigo or fear of moving forward, slowing player reactions.

		Counter: Visual anchors in the room (rug, furniture) indicate real floor positions.

-- STALKER: ALIGN-BASED APPROACH WITH FLOATING (FULL SERVER SCRIPT)
-- Drop this over your BASEmodel. Keeps Motor6Ds active while pulling the rig to an anchored mover.
-- Floating is implemented via a small upward offset (floatHeight) applied to the mover & attachment.

local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local TweenService = game:GetService("TweenService")
local Workspace = game:GetService("Workspace")

local model = script.Parent
if not model or not model:IsA("Model") then
	warn("[Stalker-Float] Script must be parented to the BASEmodel Model.")
	return
end

-- ======== CONFIG ========
local debugMode = false           -- set true to visualize the mover and enable verbose logging
local approachDistance = 10
local behindDotThreshold = -0.5
local stalkHoldLoop = true
local walkThreshold = 1
local checkInterval = 0.2 -- seconds
local movementFailsafeTime = 2.0 -- seconds

-- movement/tween segmentation
local tweenSpeed = 6      -- studs per second (match to walk animation cadence)
local maxSegment = 2      -- studs per segment (smaller -> smoother)

-- raycast / stepping config
local groundRayDown = 10
local groundRayUp = 5
local maxStepUp = 1.6
local horizontalRayHeight = 1.2

-- FLOATING config
local floatHeight = 0.6   -- how many studs above the ground the rig should float; typical: 0.3 - 0.9

-- Align settings (tuned defaults)
local alignResponsiveness = 110   -- higher = stiffer tracking of the mover
local alignMaxForce = 200000      -- MaxForce for AlignPosition
local alignMaxTorque = 200000     -- MaxTorque for AlignOrientation
-- ========================

-- ======== REFERENCES & VALIDATION ========
local humanoid = model:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
local primary = model.PrimaryPart or model:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
local animFolder = model:FindFirstChild("Animations")

if not humanoid then
	warn("[Stalker-Float] No Humanoid found in model. Aborting.")
	return
end
if not primary then
	warn("[Stalker-Float] No PrimaryPart/HumanoidRootPart found on model. Aborting.")
	return
end
if not animFolder or not animFolder:IsA("Folder") then
	warn("[Stalker-Float] Animations folder not found under model. Aborting.")
	return
end

pcall(function() humanoid.PlatformStand = false end)

local animator = humanoid:FindFirstChildOfClass("Animator")
if not animator then
	warn("[Stalker-Float] Animator not found as child of Humanoid. Aborting.")
	return
end

local function findAnim(name)
	local a = animFolder:FindFirstChild(name)
	if not a or not a:IsA("Animation") then
		warn(string.format("[Stalker-Float] Animation '%s' missing or not an Animation object.", name))
		return nil
	end
	if not a.AnimationId or a.AnimationId == "" then
		warn(string.format("[Stalker-Float] Animation '%s' has empty AnimationId.", name))
		return nil
	end
	return a
end

local animIdle = findAnim("Idle")
local animWalk = findAnim("Walk")
local animStalkStart = findAnim("StalkStart")
local animStalkHold = findAnim("StalkHold")
if not (animIdle and animWalk and animStalkStart and animStalkHold) then
	warn("[Stalker-Float] One or more required animations missing. Aborting.")
	return
end

local ok, trackIdle = pcall(function() return animator:LoadAnimation(animIdle) end)
local ok2, trackWalk = pcall(function() return animator:LoadAnimation(animWalk) end)
local ok3, trackStalkStart = pcall(function() return animator:LoadAnimation(animStalkStart) end)
local ok4, trackStalkHold = pcall(function() return animator:LoadAnimation(animStalkHold) end)
if not (ok and ok2 and ok3 and ok4 and trackIdle and trackWalk and trackStalkStart and trackStalkHold) then
	warn("[Stalker-Float] Failed to LoadAnimation. Check AnimationIds and Animator.")
	return
end

trackIdle.Looped = true
trackWalk.Looped = true
trackStalkHold.Looped = stalkHoldLoop
trackStalkStart.Looped = false

-- ======== STATE ========
local currentTrack = nil
local isMoving = false
local isStalking = false
local stalkTargetPlayer = nil
local originalWalkSpeed = humanoid.WalkSpeed or 16
local lastWalkSpeedChangeTime = tick()

local function dbg(...)
	if debugMode then
		print("[Stalker-Float]", ...)
	end
end

local function playTrack(newTrack, looped)
	if currentTrack and currentTrack ~= newTrack then
		pcall(function() currentTrack:Stop(0.15) end)
	end
	currentTrack = newTrack
	if not currentTrack then return end
	if looped ~= nil then currentTrack.Looped = looped end
	pcall(function() currentTrack:Play() end)
end

local function stopTrack(track)
	if not track then return end
	pcall(function() track:Stop(0.1) end)
	if currentTrack == track then currentTrack = nil end
end

humanoid.Running:Connect(function(speed)
	isMoving = (speed > walkThreshold)
end)

-- ======== UTIL: player behind & in range ========
local function isPlayerBehindAndInRange(player)
	if not player or not player.Character then return false end
	local pRoot = player.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
	local pHum = player.Character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
	if not pRoot or not pHum or pHum.Health <= 0 then return false end

	local playerPos = pRoot.Position
	local npcPos = primary.Position
	local vectorToNPC = npcPos - playerPos
	local dist = vectorToNPC.Magnitude
	if dist > approachDistance then return false end
	if dist == 0 then return false end

	local toNPC = vectorToNPC.Unit
	local playerLook = pRoot.CFrame.LookVector
	local dot = playerLook:Dot(toNPC)
	return dot < behindDotThreshold
end

-- ======== RESTORE MOVEMENT ========
local function restoreMovementState()
	if humanoid and humanoid.Parent then
		pcall(function()
			humanoid.WalkSpeed = originalWalkSpeed or 16
			humanoid.PlatformStand = false
			pcall(function() humanoid.AutoRotate = true end)
		end)
	end
	lastWalkSpeedChangeTime = tick()
end

-- ======== RAYCAST HELPERS ========
local function computeBehindPoint(playerRoot, distance)
	distance = distance or 2
	local look = playerRoot.CFrame.LookVector
	local behindPos = playerRoot.Position - look * distance
	behindPos = Vector3.new(behindPos.X, playerRoot.Position.Y, behindPos.Z)
	return CFrame.new(behindPos)
end

local function findGroundYAt(pos, blacklist)
	local params = RaycastParams.new()
	params.FilterDescendantsInstances = blacklist or {model}
	params.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Blacklist
	local origin = pos + Vector3.new(0, groundRayUp, 0)
	local result = Workspace:Raycast(origin, Vector3.new(0, -groundRayDown, 0), params)
	if result and result.Position then
		return result.Position.Y, result
	end
	return nil, nil
end

local function horizontalObstacleBetween(originPos, targetPos, blacklist)
	local direction = (targetPos - originPos)
	local len = direction.Magnitude
	if len <= 0 then return nil end
	local dirUnit = direction.Unit
	local origin = originPos + Vector3.new(0, horizontalRayHeight, 0)
	local params = RaycastParams.new()
	params.FilterDescendantsInstances = blacklist or {model}
	params.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Blacklist
	local result = Workspace:Raycast(origin, dirUnit * len, params)
	return result
end

-- ======== ALIGN-BASED SEGMENTED MOVER (with float) ========
local function segmentedAlignMoveToWithRaycast(targetCFrame, speed, segmentMax)
	if not primary then
		dbg("No primary; aborting segmented move.")
		return false
	end
	speed = speed or tweenSpeed
	segmentMax = segmentMax or maxSegment

	local startPos = primary.Position
	local targetPos = targetCFrame.Position
	local totalVec = targetPos - startPos
	local totalDist = totalVec.Magnitude
	if totalDist <= 0.01 then
		dbg("segment totalDist ~0; nothing to do.")
		return true
	end

	local direction = totalVec.Unit
	local remaining = totalDist
	local currentPos = startPos
	local halfHeight = (primary:GetExtentsSize().Y or 2) / 2

	local blacklist = {model}

	-- create mover (anchored) and attachments/aligns
	local mover = Instance.new("Part")
	mover.Name = "StalkerMover"
	mover.Size = Vector3.new(0.2, 0.2, 0.2)
	mover.CanCollide = false
	mover.Anchored = true
	-- debug visibility
	if debugMode then
		mover.Transparency = 0.6
		mover.BrickColor = BrickColor.new("Bright violet")
	else
		mover.Transparency = 1
	end
	-- start mover slightly raised so float is applied from the beginning
	mover.CFrame = primary.CFrame + Vector3.new(0, floatHeight, 0)
	mover.Parent = Workspace
	dbg("Created mover at", tostring(mover.Position))

	local attRig = Instance.new("Attachment")
	attRig.Name = "StalkerAtt_Rig"
	-- raise the rig attachment so Align pulls the rig up by floatHeight
	attRig.Position = Vector3.new(0, floatHeight, 0)
	attRig.Parent = primary

	local attMover = Instance.new("Attachment")
	attMover.Name = "StalkerAtt_Mover"
	attMover.Parent = mover

	local alignPos = Instance.new("AlignPosition")
	alignPos.Name = "StalkerAlignPos"
	alignPos.Attachment0 = attRig
	alignPos.Attachment1 = attMover
	alignPos.RigidityEnabled = true
	alignPos.Responsiveness = alignResponsiveness
	alignPos.MaxForce = alignMaxForce
	alignPos.ReactionForceEnabled = false
	alignPos.Parent = primary

	local alignOri = Instance.new("AlignOrientation")
	alignOri.Name = "StalkerAlignOri"
	alignOri.Attachment0 = attRig
	alignOri.Attachment1 = attMover
	alignOri.RigidityEnabled = true
	alignOri.Responsiveness = alignResponsiveness
	alignOri.MaxTorque = alignMaxTorque
	alignOri.ReactionTorqueEnabled = false
	alignOri.Parent = primary

	local function cleanupMover()
		pcall(function()
			if alignPos and alignPos.Parent then alignPos:Destroy() end
			if alignOri and alignOri.Parent then alignOri:Destroy() end
			if attRig and attRig.Parent then attRig:Destroy() end
			if attMover and attMover.Parent then attMover:Destroy() end
			if mover and mover.Parent then mover:Destroy() end
		end)
		dbg("cleaned up mover and aligns")
	end

	-- Ensure humanoid not PlatformStand here so motors animate limbs and align pulls properly
	pcall(function()
		humanoid.PlatformStand = false
		pcall(function() humanoid.AutoRotate = true end)
	end)

	-- segment loop
	local segIndex = 0
	while remaining > 0 do
		if not isStalking then
			dbg("stalking cancelled during segments")
			cleanupMover()
			return false
		end

		local segLen = math.min(segmentMax, remaining)
		local rawSegTarget = currentPos + direction * segLen

		-- ground check under raw target
		local groundY, groundHit = findGroundYAt(rawSegTarget, blacklist)
		if not groundY then
			dbg("No ground under seg target; aborting. rawSegTarget:", rawSegTarget)
			cleanupMover()
			return false
		end

		-- apply floatHeight on top of the usual Y (halfHeight + float)
		local segTarget = Vector3.new(rawSegTarget.X, groundY + halfHeight + floatHeight, rawSegTarget.Z)

		-- horizontal obstacle check/step-up
		local hHit = horizontalObstacleBetween(currentPos, segTarget, blacklist)
		if hHit then
			local tryUp = 0.0
			local stepped = false
			while tryUp <= maxStepUp do
				tryUp = tryUp + 0.2
				local testPos = Vector3.new(rawSegTarget.X, segTarget.Y + tryUp, rawSegTarget.Z)
				local testGroundY = findGroundYAt(testPos, blacklist)
				if testGroundY then
					if testGroundY + halfHeight <= segTarget.Y + tryUp + 0.5 then
						segTarget = Vector3.new(rawSegTarget.X, testGroundY + halfHeight + floatHeight, rawSegTarget.Z)
						stepped = true
						break
					end
				end
			end
			if not stepped then
				dbg("Obstacle too high; aborting approach at segTarget:", segTarget)
				cleanupMover()
				return false
			end
		end

		-- skip very tiny moves to avoid jitter
		local segDistFromMover = (mover.Position - segTarget).Magnitude
		if segDistFromMover < 0.01 then
			currentPos = segTarget
			remaining = (targetPos - currentPos).Magnitude
			dbg("segment", segIndex, "skipped tiny move (", segDistFromMover, ")")
			segIndex = segIndex + 1
			continue
		end

		-- orient target to preserve current facing
		local segCFrame = CFrame.new(segTarget, segTarget + primary.CFrame.LookVector)

		-- tween mover
		local duration = math.max(0.02, segDistFromMover / speed)
		local tweenInfo = TweenInfo.new(duration, Enum.EasingStyle.Linear, Enum.EasingDirection.Out)
		local ok, tween = pcall(function() return TweenService:Create(mover, tweenInfo, {CFrame = segCFrame}) end)
		if not ok or not tween then
			dbg("Failed to create tween for mover at seg", segIndex)
			cleanupMover()
			return false
		end

		dbg("segment", segIndex, "tweening mover ->", tostring(segTarget), "duration", duration)
		local done = false
		local con
		con = tween.Completed:Connect(function()
			done = true
			if con then con:Disconnect() end
		end)
		tween:Play()

		while not done do
			if not isStalking then
				pcall(function() tween:Cancel() end)
				dbg("cancelled tween because stalking stopped")
				cleanupMover()
				return false
			end
			RunService.Heartbeat:Wait()
		end

		-- progress
		currentPos = segTarget
		remaining = (targetPos - currentPos).Magnitude
		segIndex = segIndex + 1
	end

	-- small settle
	local settleT = 0
	while settleT < 0.06 do
		RunService.Heartbeat:Wait()
		settleT = settleT + RunService.Heartbeat:Wait()
	end

	cleanupMover()
	return true
end

-- ======== TWEEN APPROACH WRAPPER ========
local function tweenApproachPlayer(player, behindDistance)
	if not player or not player.Character then
		dbg("tweenApproachPlayer: invalid player or no character")
		return false
	end
	local pRoot = player.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
	if not pRoot then
		dbg("tweenApproachPlayer: player missing HumanoidRootPart")
		return false
	end

	local targetCF = computeBehindPoint(pRoot, behindDistance or 2.5)
	dbg("computed behind targetCF:", tostring(targetCF.p))

	-- Play walk animation while moving; set WalkSpeed to 0 so Running events don't interfere
	pcall(function()
		humanoid.WalkSpeed = 0
		pcall(function() humanoid.AutoRotate = true end)
	end)
	lastWalkSpeedChangeTime = tick()

	playTrack(trackWalk, true)

	local ok = segmentedAlignMoveToWithRaycast(targetCF, tweenSpeed, maxSegment)

	stopTrack(trackWalk)

	dbg("tweenApproachPlayer result:", ok)
	return ok
end

-- ======== STALKING FLOW (server authoritative) ========
local function startStalkingOnPlayer(player)
	if not player then
		dbg("startStalkingOnPlayer called with nil player")
		return
	end
	if isStalking and stalkTargetPlayer == player then
		dbg("already stalking this player; ignoring")
		return
	end

	if isStalking and stalkTargetPlayer ~= player then
		dbg("cleaning previous stalking state")
		isStalking = false
		stalkTargetPlayer = nil
		wait(0.05)
	end

	if not player.Character then
		dbg("player has no character; abort")
		return
	end

	isStalking = true
	stalkTargetPlayer = player

	originalWalkSpeed = originalWalkSpeed or humanoid.WalkSpeed or 16

	if not isPlayerBehindAndInRange(player) then
		dbg("player not behind/in range; aborting start")
		restoreMovementState()
		isStalking = false
		stalkTargetPlayer = nil
		return
	end

	dbg("starting tween approach to player:", player.Name)
	local ok = tweenApproachPlayer(player, 2.5)
	if not ok then
		dbg("approach failed; restoring movement")
		restoreMovementState()
		isStalking = false
		stalkTargetPlayer = nil
		return
	end

	-- verify still valid
	if not isStalking or not stalkTargetPlayer or not stalkTargetPlayer.Character or not isPlayerBehindAndInRange(stalkTargetPlayer) then
		dbg("post-approach verification failed")
		restoreMovementState()
		isStalking = false
		stalkTargetPlayer = nil
		return
	end

	-- Play StalkStart -> StalkHold
	pcall(function()
		humanoid.PlatformStand = false
		humanoid.WalkSpeed = 0
		pcall(function() humanoid.AutoRotate = true end)
	end)
	lastWalkSpeedChangeTime = tick()

	stopTrack(trackIdle)
	stopTrack(trackWalk)
	playTrack(trackStalkStart, false)

	local finished = false
	local conn = trackStalkStart.Stopped:Connect(function() finished = true end)

	while isStalking and not finished do
		local dt = RunService.Heartbeat:Wait()
		if dt and dt > 0 then
			if not stalkTargetPlayer or not stalkTargetPlayer.Character then
				dbg("stalk target vanished during StalkStart")
				isStalking = false
				break
			end
			if not isPlayerBehindAndInRange(stalkTargetPlayer) then
				dbg("stalk condition no longer valid during StalkStart")
				isStalking = false
				break
			end
		end
	end

	if conn then conn:Disconnect() end

	if not isStalking then
		stopTrack(trackStalkStart)
		restoreMovementState()
		stalkTargetPlayer = nil
		return
	end

	stopTrack(trackStalkStart)
	playTrack(trackStalkHold, stalkHoldLoop)

	while isStalking do
		local dt = RunService.Heartbeat:Wait()
		if dt and dt > 0 then
			if not stalkTargetPlayer or not stalkTargetPlayer.Character then
				dbg("target gone during hold; ending")
				isStalking = false
				break
			end
			if not isPlayerBehindAndInRange(stalkTargetPlayer) then
				dbg("target moved; ending hold")
				isStalking = false
				break
			end
		end
	end

	stopTrack(trackStalkHold)
	restoreMovementState()
	stalkTargetPlayer = nil
	isStalking = false
end

-- ======== Remote & loops ========
local remote = model:FindFirstChild("ForceStalk")
if not remote then
	remote = Instance.new("RemoteEvent")
	remote.Name = "ForceStalk"
	remote.Parent = model
end

remote.OnServerEvent:Connect(function(player, ...)
	if player and Players:FindFirstChild(player.Name) then
		spawn(function()
			startStalkingOnPlayer(player)
		end)
	end
end)

-- Automatic scanning loop (checks players for behind+inRange). Also handles idle/walk.
spawn(function()
	wait(0.15)
	while model and model.Parent do
		if not isStalking then
			local chosenPlayer = nil
			local chosenDist = math.huge
			for _, player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
				if player.Character and player.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") then
					if isPlayerBehindAndInRange(player) then
						local d = (player.Character.HumanoidRootPart.Position - primary.Position).Magnitude
						if d < chosenDist then
							chosenPlayer = player
							chosenDist = d
						end
					end
				end
			end

			if chosenPlayer then
				dbg("scanner found player to stalk:", chosenPlayer.Name)
				spawn(function()
					startStalkingOnPlayer(chosenPlayer)
				end)
			else
				-- Normal animations
				if isMoving then
					if currentTrack ~= trackWalk then
						playTrack(trackWalk, true)
					end
				else
					if currentTrack ~= trackIdle then
						playTrack(trackIdle, true)
					end
				end
			end
		end

		-- Wait in increments using Heartbeat
		local acc = 0
		while acc < checkInterval and model and model.Parent do
			acc = acc + RunService.Heartbeat:Wait()
		end
	end
end)

-- Movement failsafe watchdog
spawn(function()
	while model and model.Parent do
		if not isStalking then
			local ws = nil
			pcall(function() ws = humanoid.WalkSpeed end)
			if ws == 0 and (tick() - lastWalkSpeedChangeTime) > movementFailsafeTime then
				warn("[Stalker-Float] Movement failsafe triggered. Restoring WalkSpeed.")
				restoreMovementState()
			end
		end
		local acc = 0
		while acc < 0.5 and model and model.Parent do
			acc = acc + RunService.Heartbeat:Wait()
		end
	end
end)

-- Cleanup when model removed
model.AncestryChanged:Connect(function()
	if not model:IsDescendantOf(game) then
		stopTrack(trackIdle)
		stopTrack(trackWalk)
		stopTrack(trackStalkStart)
		stopTrack(trackStalkHold)
		pcall(function() humanoid.WalkSpeed = originalWalkSpeed or 16 end)
	end
end)

print("[Stalker-Float] Initialized on model:", model.Name)
